sql: SELECT 'twin' AS src, t.created_at, t.market_ticker, t.side, t.assumed_price::text AS price, t.quantity::text AS qty, t.status, coalesce(t.pnl::text,'-') AS pnl FROM paper_trades t WHERE t.strategy = 'Alimm1_pt3' UNION ALL SELECT 'position', p.captured_at, p.market_ticker, '-', coalesce(p.avg_price::text,'-'), coalesce(p.quantity::text,'-'), '-', coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' AND p.captured_at > timestamptz '2026-09-17 20:00:00+00' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
